categories.short: US paycheck and tax deduction calculators built on IRS rules.
categories.metaTitle: Tax & Pay Calculators: US Deductions and Paychecks
categories.metaDescription: Free US tax and pay calculators built on current IRS rules, starting with the No Tax on Overtime deduction, with sources and review dates on every page.
intro: Tax & Pay is where Numoro keeps calculators for US paychecks and federal tax deductions. Each tool follows the current law and IRS guidance for the tax year you pick, shows the formula and every step behind the number, and lists the official sources with the date the rules were last checked.

The first calculator covers the deduction for qualified overtime under the 2025 tax law, often called "no tax on overtime". It works out the half-time premium, applies the $12,500 or $25,000 cap and the income phase-out, and estimates the federal tax you save. These are estimates to help you plan and check your W-2, not tax advice: confirm the final figure with your tax software or a tax professional.

categories.name: E-commerce Fees
categories.short: Marketplace fee and profit calculators for online sellers.
categories.metaTitle: E-commerce Fee Calculators for Etsy & TikTok Shop
categories.metaDescription: Marketplace fee calculators for online sellers. See Etsy and TikTok Shop fees line by line, your real profit and margin, and the price you need to charge.
intro: Marketplace fees are easy to underestimate: a sale that looks profitable at list price can lose money once transaction, payment processing, advertising and affiliate fees are taken out. The E-commerce Fees calculators show every deduction on a single order, then your payout, profit and margin after product and shipping costs.

Each calculator uses the platform's published rates for the seller's country, with the date we last checked them, and lets you override a rate when your account differs. Reverse mode answers the question most sellers really have: what price do I need to charge to keep a set profit? Fees change, so treat the results as estimates and compare them with your platform statements.

categories.metaDescription: Calculators for freelancers and small businesses, starting with Stripe fees, net payouts, the amount to charge to receive a target and a PayPal comparison.
intro: Business & Freelance gathers calculators for people who invoice clients, sell online or run a small business. The first tool is a Stripe fee calculator: it shows the processing fee on a payment for a US or UK Stripe account, including international card, currency conversion and manual entry surcharges, and what actually lands in your account.

Reverse mode tells you how much to charge so you receive an exact amount after fees, which is useful when quoting a client or passing card fees on. A side-by-side comparison shows what the same payment would cost through PayPal. Rates come from each provider's published standard pricing, dated on the page, and you can enter your own negotiated rate instead.

categories.metaTitle: Energy & EV Calculators: Charging and Power Costs
categories.metaDescription: Energy and EV calculators with dated state electricity prices: work out EV charging cost per session, per mile and per month, and compare it with gasoline.
intro: Energy & EV is for working out what electricity really costs you. The EV Charging Cost Calculator turns your battery size, charge level and electricity rate into the cost of one charging session, the cost per mile and per 100 miles, and a weekly, monthly and yearly running cost based on how far you drive.

It includes average residential electricity prices for every US state from the U.S. Energy Information Administration, with the month the data covers, and it accounts for the energy lost while charging. An optional comparison shows what the same miles would cost in a gasoline car. For the most accurate answer, type in the rate from your own electricity bill.

categories.metaTitle: Health Calculators: BMI, Calories, Water & Heart
categories.metaDescription: Free health calculators for BMI, daily calories, water intake, body fat, steps to calories and heart-rate zones, using standard published formulas.
intro: Numoro's health calculators turn a few measurements into numbers that are useful for planning: Body Mass Index, daily calorie needs, how much water to drink, estimated body fat, calories burned from steps and heart-rate training zones. Each one uses a standard, widely published formula and shows a clear breakdown of the result.

These tools give general estimates for healthy adults. They can't account for medical conditions, pregnancy, medications or individual differences, so use them as a starting point and talk to a doctor or registered dietitian before making significant changes to your diet or exercise. Each page lists the inputs it needs, and nothing you type is stored or sent anywhere.

categories.name: Finance
categories.metaDescription: Free finance calculators for simple and compound interest, loan EMIs, mortgage payments, investment returns and currency conversion, with clear breakdowns.
intro: The finance calculators cover the everyday money questions: how much interest a loan or deposit earns, what a monthly loan or mortgage payment will be, and how an investment could grow with regular contributions. Each one shows the result with a breakdown of interest versus principal or contributions versus growth.

Results are estimates based on the numbers you enter and the standard formulas for each product. Lenders may add fees, round payments differently or use other compounding rules, so check the official quote before you sign anything. For marketplace and payment fees, see the E-commerce Fees and Business & Freelance calculators, which use dated fee schedules.

categories.metaDescription: Free unit converters for length, weight, temperature, speed, area and volume, using exact conversion factors between metric and imperial units.
intro: Numoro's unit converters switch between metric and imperial units for length, weight, temperature, speed, area and volume. They use exact, standard conversion factors (for example, one inch is exactly 2.54 centimeters) and format the result so it's easy to copy.

Use them for recipes, travel, shopping, homework or engineering estimates. For very large or very small numbers, check the number of decimal places you need before relying on the rounded display. Every converter runs in your browser, so nothing you type is sent anywhere, and each page explains which units it supports. If you need a unit that isn't listed, the Maths & Science calculators can help with the arithmetic.

categories.name: Maths & Science

intro: The maths and science calculators are built for students, teachers and anyone checking their working. There's a full scientific calculator, an algebra solver for linear and quadratic equations, geometry formulas for common 2D and 3D shapes, and physics and chemistry tools that keep track of units.

Where it helps, the calculators show the formula and the steps, so you can follow the method rather than just copy an answer. Numbers are worked out in your browser with standard formulas, and results are rounded only for display. If you are learning a topic, try the problem by hand first, then use the calculator to check each step and spot where a mistake crept in.

intro: Everyday Life collects the small calculations that come up all the time: splitting a restaurant bill and tip, finding an exact age, working out a sale price, counting days between dates, converting a meeting time to another time zone and calculating a grade point average.

They're quick to use on a phone, need no sign-up and run entirely in your browser, so nothing you enter is saved. The date tools follow the Gregorian calendar, including leap years, and the time-zone converter uses the time-zone rules built into your browser, so daylight-saving time is taken into account.
